summary: Run sheets for BW21_0240 (Tervemere Pharma AG, TP04 aminopyrazolopyrimidine series 04): plate acceptance, primary IC50 for all 24 compounds against the inflammatory-signal kinase and the 16-kinase selectivity sweep at 1 µM on six of them. Accepted 19 August 2021; the scaffold change reduced off-target activity.

sheets.name: Summary

rows.v: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company
BW21_0240 run sheets: TP04 kinase selectivity after scaffold substitution

rows: The revised hinge core reduced off-target activity. Tervemere kept the polar substituents for the next design cycle.

comments.text: Client name as it stood on the 2021 quote. Tervemere is the legal name used on the signed statement of work.
comments.author: Ines Alvarado

sheets.name: Plate acceptance
rows: Acceptance as per study plan. Reference inhibitor and vehicle both within the historical range on every plate; the selectivity plates were read against the same reference.

rows.v: Plate acceptance: all four plates accepted for the final fit.

comments.text: Re-dispense on PA-13 was a pipetting correction before read, not a re-run. Noted here for the record.
comments.author: Stéphane Guillaume

sheets.name: Primary IC50

rows.v: Inflammatory-signal kinase IC50, 10-point concentration response, ATP at Km

rows: Hill slopes outside the study plan window were re-fitted with the top fixed before the value was accepted. Replicate fits are on the run sheet.

sheets.name: Selectivity

rows.v: Kinase selectivity panel: % inhibition at 1 µM, six representative compounds

rows: Readings at or above 50% are flagged for a concentration response before any conclusion. Single-point only at this stage.

comments.text: Compounds with broad off-target readings were set aside. The polar substituents carried through to the next cycle held the panel down.
comments.author: Ravi Deshmukh
